thin: No list names more than a handful of Mesa housing providers: the City's pages cover only its own Housing Authority programmes, and 211's housing results for Mesa are mostly Phoenix senior complexes, veteran-only programmes and legal aid; affordable apartments and non-City rent help in Mesa itself are where Scout's search still has to do the work. Scout's matcher needed eight hand corrections to none here (Emergency Rehab, Fair Housing Center, Housing for Hope, Citadel, Kivel, Retirement Housing Foundation, HUD locator and Pet Housing Help were false matches at 0.6-1.0), and Salvation Army, DES and Veterans First were re-matched to the right agency by hand.
